description.value: Whistler Bungee has operated since 2002 with a perfect safety record, offering 160ft (50m) jumps off a bridge over the glacial Cheakamus River. The site is surrounded by basalt column cliffs, old-growth forest, and views of Black Tusk, making it one of the most scenic bungee locations in the world. It sits just off the Sea to Sky Highway about 20 minutes south of Whistler Village, directly along a major cycling corridor, with free parking at the bridge.
